notes: Gold! Enemies now sometimes drop gold coins during a run. Elites, mini-bosses and bosses drop more, and chests and quests give a pile. Your pickup radius and magnet pull coins in too
Gold is separate from Shards and resets every run. Your gold total shows on the HUD, and leftover gold adds a small Shard bonus at game over (up to +15)
Wandering traders: every few minutes a trader appears somewhere nearby. Follow the arrow at the edge of the screen. They only stay for about a minute
Walk into a trader, press E / Enter (controller X) or tap "Trade" to open their shop. The game pauses while you browse
Pell the Wandering Merchant sells healing tonics, skill lessons, rerolls and a Soul Lantern that pulls every gem and coin on the map to you
Lady Vex the Fortune Gambler offers wagers. They're mostly good, but not always
Brunhild the Runesmith reforges your weakest skill and sells 90-second buffs: Whetstone Edge (+25% damage), Quickening Rune (faster cooldowns) and Ironhide Rune (+3 armor)
Rarely, a Mysterious Stranger appears with pricey offers: an instant evolution, banishing the horde, or a Deathward that saves you once
Prices go up the longer a run lasts. Buying the same thing again costs more
Shops work fully with keyboard (number keys, arrows, Enter, Esc), controller (D-pad, A, B) and touch
